evals.name: Zero-Trust DTO Schema Validation & Whitelist Stripping
evals.prompt: Create an input validation schema for a user update endpoint that strips unexpected fields like 'role' or 'isAdmin' to prevent Mass Assignment attacks.
evals.expected_output: Defines a strict DTO schema (e.g. Zod .strict() or Pydantic extra='forbid') and asserts that undeclared fields are rejected with HTTP 400 or dropped.
assertions: Defines explicit schema validation for allowed request body fields
Enforces strict whitelisting to prevent Mass Assignment privilege escalation
Rejects or strips undeclared parameters like 'role', 'isVerified', or 'balance'
Validates standard formats including E.164 phone numbers and RFC-5322 emails

evals.name: Field-Level Error Aggregation in Standard Error Envelope
evals.prompt: Implement a validation pipe that inspects a multi-field request and aggregates all field validation failures into a structured details array rather than aborting on the first error.
evals.expected_output: Emits a VALIDATION_ERROR (400) containing an array of all field errors with field paths and localized messages.
assertions: Aggregates all schema validation failures across all submitted fields
Avoids early abort on the first encountered field failure
Returns standard { success: false, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', details: [...] } } payload
Identifies precise field path and clear error description for each failed property

evals.name: Multi-Layer Validation Boundary Separation
evals.prompt: Review an endpoint where database uniqueness checks were embedded into a DTO schema validator and refactor it according to the 3-layer validation model.
evals.expected_output: Separates Layer 1 shape/type validation in the pipe from Layer 2 business invariant checks in the application service.
assertions: Isolates transport Layer 1 schema validation from business domain rules
Ensures transport validation pipes remain pure and fast without database I/O calls
Delegates business state assertions (e.g. checking user existence) to the application service
Preserves clean architectural boundaries between controllers and domain services
